title: Prove a diagonal-span projection barrier for the PR117 word
head: be198c23d6b21c67ee9e6714dd04338c5a279cc3
body:
Restricting a completed commuting phase word to fewer address coordinates preserves its algebraic identity, but can add internal frame cost. I prove that every nonzero binary row-isometric restriction within the 24 diagonal tensor axes fails positive coverage for the original PR117 carrier schedule.

For each nonzero projection column, the first-stage helper paths force at least 317,823,660 extra rank units. The data can save at most 32,388,554 units per odd-norm column. The resulting margin, 285,435,106 per nonzero column, excludes even the zero-saving moment. The proof grants free centres and permits constant gauges, bank concatenation and catalytic helpers; it retains the original scalar incidences and commuting frames.

The six-file package includes the proof, attribution and a standard-library verifier. It regenerates the exact 71,185-arc matching and 28,705 physical carrier paths from the pinned DAG, then recomputes all 24 coordinate defects. Reviewers need no C++ compiler or bundled matching fixture.

Validation:

- Registered replay passes on Python 3.12 with `-I -O -B`; direct optimized replay also passes on Python 3.14.
- Seven corrupted inputs/paths fail, and 136 small isometries pass the exact phase controls.
- Metadata/source pins and `git diff --check` pass. The universal theorem relies on the written argument; these checks do not constitute formal proof verification.

Scope: this result does not improve the multiplication exponent. A changed internal schedule, carrier assignment, frame family or projection outside the diagonal span remains open. I leave the selected frontier and frozen sources unchanged.

Credit: eumemic/PR117 supplied the DAG and producer; icekylinx supplied the retained matching and physical compiler; Rohan Arun supplied prior weighted matching. I preserve the predecessor notices and disclosures. Jose Manuel (@jmbarrancoml) prepared this contribution with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and read-only mathematical subagents; no independent human review.

Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18926218
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
